info.name: SONA CLI acceptance
info.description: Read-only product/access requests and private Identity Platform authentication. Never commit populated environments or export run credentials. Live authentication is not certified by emulator runs. See docs/cli/postman/README.md.

exec: // Serialize credentials rather than interpolating passwords into raw JSON.
pm.test("Enrolled TOTP factor exists", function () { pm.expect(factor).to.be.an("object"); });
if (body.idToken && body.refreshToken) { pm.environment.set("idToken", body.idToken); pm.environment.set("refreshToken", body.refreshToken); }
if (body.id_token && body.refresh_token) { pm.environment.set("idToken", body.id_token); pm.environment.set("refreshToken", body.refresh_token); }

pm.test("Release integrity contract", function () { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.version).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(data.sha256).to.match(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/); pm.expect(data.downloadPath).to.eql("/api/cli/download"); });
